title: Excellent option for busy entrepreneurs
body: I’ve just started using this app, and the timed text messages are really helping me stay on top of scheduled customer phone calls.  I NEVER leave app reviews… but I just had to take a moment to say how much of a stress reliever this app has been for me in such a short period of time.
author: Tashabing
